Container.Name: shazzzbot
Container.Overview: A Discord bot that keeps one self-updating status message for this Unraid server. This template runs the bot only. The Docker section and the /docker commands need the docker-proxy container, and the Tasks section needs the host helper. setup.sh in the repository sets up both. Without them the bot runs in bot-only mode: leave docker_proxy out of config.toml.
Container.Requires: Create config.toml with mode 600 and owner 10001, and a data directory owned by 10001. Enter their absolute paths below. The helper uses /tmp/shazzzbot-helper/socket for its temporary socket. Create the shazzzbot Docker network before starting this bot-only template. setup.sh prepares these paths.

Config.Name: Bot token
Config.Description: The token from the Bot page of the Discord Developer Portal. Not used by the relay role.

Config.Name: Config file
Config.Description: Bot role: private config.toml outside exported shares, created before the first start. Unused by the relay role.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Private persistent data directory. Owner must be user id 10001.

Config.Name: Host proc
Config.Description: Host CPU, memory, and process readings.

Config.Name: Unraid state
Config.Description: Unraid array, disk, and share state.

Config.Name: Helper socket directory
Config.Description: Temporary helper socket. Docker can create the directory; the helper checks and normalizes its permissions in place.

Config.Name: Node role
Config.Description: bot runs the Discord bot. relay runs only the service-check relay: then set Relay names and Relay port, and the Discord, config, and host settings are not used.

Config.Name: Relay names
Config.Description: Relay role only: the host names or IPs the relay may check, separated by spaces.

Config.Name: Relay port
Config.Description: Relay role only: the host port for the relay, usually 8443. Leave empty for the bot role.

Config.Name: Helper key
Config.Description: The content of the helper api.key. Leave empty without the helper.
